results.title: PostgreSQL: Documentation: Index Types
results.snippet: PostgreSQL provides several index types: B-tree, Hash, GiST, SP-GiST, GIN, BRIN. Each index type uses a different algorithm best suited to different types of queries.

results.title: PostgreSQL: Documentation: Using EXPLAIN
results.snippet: PostgreSQL devises a query plan for each query it receives. EXPLAIN shows that plan, including whether a scan is a sequential scan or an index scan.

results.title: The B-Tree — Use The Index, Luke!
results.snippet: A B-tree index keeps its entries sorted, which is what makes a lookup a logarithmic walk down the tree rather than a full scan of the table.
